title: With Make new Chromium tab pages ahead on, a new Chromium tab takes the page made ahead: one Back entry, the page sized to its pane, DevTools attaches
why: HOT PATH AUDIT browser (#34252): with the Debug Setting browserPage.sparePage on (off by default), a new Chromium tab's browser is a spare page made at an idle moment in the hidden spare window, frozen while it waits, thawed and moved into the pane's window by the tab that takes it. The stand-in shim tests (CEFSparePageTests) cannot show what the real fork does with it. This journey turns the setting on, waits until debug.cef reports a page waiting, opens a second tab in the same pane, and proves that tab took the page (spare_pages_taken 1). It then checks that the page has one history entry (it was made with an empty URL, so no blank entry before the tab's first navigation), that the page's viewport is its pane's page area, and that DevTools attaches to it. The setting is reset at the end.
source: coordinator review of #34252 (hpa-browser), item 4; re-review at 82b52979, item 2

steps.title: turn on Debug Settings > Browser Page Loading > Make new Chromium tab pages ahead
a first Chromium tab: Chromium starts and builds this pane's window
the first tab shows example.com, the spare window came up after its window, and no page was taken yet
no input: the next idle moments (0.75 s each) make the spare page in the spare window
a second Chromium tab in the same pane's live window: it takes the spare page, which moves in
the second tab took the spare page, shows its page, and its page area is laid out
one history entry (no blank entry before the first navigation); the page's viewport is its pane's page area (points, rounded)

params.expression: 'hist=' + history.length + ' ' + (innerWidth === Math.round(Number('${page_w}')) && innerHeight === Math.round(Number('${page_h}')) ? 'sized' : 'unsized ' + innerWidth + 'x' + innerHeight + ' pane ${page_w}x${page_h}')

steps.title: Developer Tools: Open Docked on the taken page
DevTools attached to the taken page, docked beside it

finally.title: put Make new Chromium tab pages ahead back to its default (off)
